evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Not present. Rep jumped directly into logistics: 'Okay. When would you like to do the move so I can check the availability?' with no time-boxed framing or promise of a dependable quote.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked after probing started. Rep gathered pickup address, apartment type, floor, elevator/stairs, walking distance, furniture items, and boxes before asking: 'Before I discuss the pricing structure and your estimate, do you have any concerns about the moving process.' By this point, most discovery was already complete.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — customer answered 'No, I don't' to the concerns question, so no concerns were raised to follow up on.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — no concerns raised, so no reflection needed.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Full. Gathered: property type (apartment), floor (second floor pickup, third floor dropoff), rooms (2 bedrooms), walking distances (parking to stairs, stairs to apartment on both ends), furniture and special items (queen metal bed, love seat, recliner, 44 books, kitchen/bathroom items), and additional stops (none).
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Not offered. Rep did not ask if customer wanted packing services.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Yes. Rep asked 'Do you have an estimated number of boxes?' and followed with 'So basically... normally ma'am you see 25 to 35 boxes. Do you think you would fall within that range?'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full. Rep provided a range tied to move specifics: 'Looking for your move since we're only moving few pieces of furniture and mostly it will be boxes from a second floor apartment to a third floor apartment. Both with their access only, I estimate your ma'am to be on the minimum of two and a half to three and a half hours. So the estimated cost is between $515 to $721.'
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full. Rep disclosed hourly rate ($206/hour for two movers), what's included (gas, truck, taxes, insurance, wraps, pads, disassembly/reassembly tools), stated 'no hidden fees of any type,' explained the 2.5-hour minimum and 15-minute increments at $51.50 per increment.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. After giving the estimate range, rep transitioned directly to booking: 'but of course this is only an estimate. If the move will only take us...' and then the customer asked 'And to book the appointment what do I need to do for today?' The rep never asked 'Does that feel fair?' and never held silence for a response.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Not mentioned. The Two Promises section was skipped entirely. No mention of on-time guarantee or any discount for lateness.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Not mentioned. No coverage promise, no $2,000 coverage, no no-deductible framing.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: False. Rep did not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or any version of that closing line for the Two Promises section.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Throwaway. Rep asked 'Any more questions before I let you go' — which is the empty, automatic 'any questions?' that does not constitute a genuine final concerns check. This is the opposite of the rubric's recognizable version: 'What's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.followup_on_remaining_concern: N/A — customer said 'No, no more questions,' so nothing to follow up on.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: False. Rep did not ask 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Full. Rep said 'Mm-hmm I just need your approval ma'am. That you want to be on the schedule for Friday' and customer responded 'Okay. Yes I would like to reserve the appointment.' This is a plain ask with no built-in out.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: False. No mention of rate-lock or price hold language.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Rep confirmed date (Friday, October 9th), arrival window (8:30 AM to 9:00 AM), pickup address (21739 Hardy Oak Boulevard, unit 5104), and dropoff address (14811 Huber Road, unit 1309). Missing: phone number confirmation (already captured but not confirmed back), crew size (not mentioned), and crew notes about customer concerns (not provided — and customer had no concerns anyway, so this is less critical, but still not done).

top_strength: Comprehensive logistics probing — the rep gathered all seven key details (property type, floors, room count, walking distances, furniture, special items, box count) methodically and confirmed details like the correct spelling of the street name, ensuring accuracy in the estimate.
coaching_note: Section 5 (Two Promises) was entirely skipped — the rep never delivered the On-Time Guarantee or No Worries Damage Coverage promises, both of which are load-bearing differentiators and must be included on every full sales call before booking.
